tagline: HTTP routing for a private server with multiple service accounts
brief: A broker that owns Caddy and TLS on a private server, authorizes each service account by its OS uid, and applies only the routes that account is allowed. For developers and self-hosters.
criteria: Success: reads as a cop at a glance, avoids network/shield/globe clichés, recognizable at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Traffic-light cap
concepts.idea: A peaked police cap whose band carries a traffic light.
rationale: The cop is the name: no explanation needed
Red, yellow, green lights: the traffic half of the name
Built on exact 15°/60°/105° angles; small-size cut for favicons

recommendation: Road-band cap in police navy with traffic-light accents, set with Barlow SemiBold (a typeface designed after highway signs).
next_steps: Add the favicon set to docs and README
Use the horizontal lockup in the README header
Run a trademark search before any public launch
